python3 -c "import re
def slugify(text: str, sep: str = '-') -> str:
    tokens = re.findall(r'[a-zA-Z0-9]+', text)
    return sep.join(tokens).lower()

print(repr(slugify('  Hello, World!! ')))
print(repr(slugify('A B', sep='_')))
print(repr(slugify('---')))
print(repr(slugify('')))
print(repr(slugify('  a b  ', sep='--')))
"

python3 -c "
from textkit.slug import slugify

assert slugify('  Hello, World!! ') == 'hello-world'
assert slugify('A B', sep='_') == 'a_b'
assert slugify('foo') == 'foo'
assert slugify('Foo Bar Baz') == 'foo-bar-baz'
assert slugify('') == ''
assert slugify('---') == ''
assert slugify('!@#$%^&*()') == ''
assert slugify('hello_world') == 'hello-world'
assert slugify('hello-world') == 'hello-world'
assert slugify('123 456') == '123-456'
print('All slugify tests passed!')
"
